about: dynaCERT Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, engineering, testing, manufacturing, and distribution of transportable hydrogen generator aftermarket products in Europe, Canada, and internationally. The company provides patent pending aftermarket retrofit product for performance enhancements by injecting hydrogen and oxygen into the air intake manifold. It also offers HydraGEN technology that turns water into hydrogen and oxygen through electrolysis; HG1 line that targets the 10-to-15-liter diesel engines; HG2, which produces hydrogen gas flows suitable for diesel engines from 2 to 8 liters in displacement; HG4C for 30-to-60-liter engines; and HG6C for 60-to-90-liter engines. In addition, the company provides HydraLytica telematics for access to fuel savings and carbon emission reduction reports. Its products have applications in trucks, reefer trailers, buses, heavy construction, mining equipment, electrical power generators, and marine markets. The company was formerly known as Dynamic Fuel Systems, Inc. and changed its name to dynaCERT Inc. in January 2013. dynaCERT Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
